about_the_game:
Astral Planes is a music driven game where play becomes performance.

You navigate a drifting craft through a reactive, cosmic space where movement, timing and restraint shape how the music unfolds. There is no single correct run. Each session is a different interpretation of the same musical system.

Features

  • Authored musical motifs that respond dynamically to play

  • Music treated as level structure rather than background soundtrack

  • Real-time performance shaped by risk, timing, and survival

  • A minimalist audiovisual world designed to foreground sound and motion

  • Runs that reward listening as much as action

Pilot. Survive. Groove.

Find your harmony.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 460 (Driver: Vulkan required)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio-compatible device
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad required
